notes.title: Color Security will become free to play shortly
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38034243/f36b632685ba53a6e7d2a3a4d37a1e4d0990b767.png[/img]

We decided to change the direction of this product to a free to play model.

After some consideration the team has decided to give color security for free.

The change will happen in the next days

notes.title: Color Security is finally out
notes.content:
Hi Vsec

After 6 months of development we are happy to announce that this small project, Color Security, is now available for purchase.
We want to thank everyone who put the game on their wishlists by supporting the project.
We ask everyone if any bugs or defects are found, or if you just have a suggestion to go to [url=https://discord.gg/4AcvHtH]our discord server[/url] where we can assist you, listen to your opinions and get to work to fix the errors.

We also invite everyone to [url=https://twitter.com/SoftwareTpose]follow us on twitte[/url]r for all the news and updates on this and other future projects that we will deal with.

Thanks everyone and have fun

TposeSoftware
